mechanism_sketch: Corrected Indeed figures are supported by public Gmail evidence; staffing agency has no hires and no activated contract. The CFO confidentiality rule is retained as a semantic gap because lexical predicates also flag safe quoted/negated refusals. A report addressing multiple channel candidates can still abstain at aggregate effect scope.

limitations: Corrected Indeed figures are supported by public Gmail evidence; staffing agency has no hires and no activated contract. The CFO confidentiality rule is retained as a semantic gap because lexical predicates also flag safe quoted/negated refusals. A report addressing multiple channel candidates can still abstain at aggregate effect scope.

Coverage is component-level only. Valid zero findings are absences, not positive outcomes. Native reference replay had no errors and preserved original scalar rewards and exact source bytes; finding replay matched after rescore and reload.

The genuine-handler controls ran with complete original task data, assertions and allowed tool data. Ordinary AutomationBenchTask reward maps were independently compared with ManifestAssessmentTask maps; all scenario maps match. These controls do not qualify the whole task.

Shared confidential report control now witnesses both the corrected Indeed figures and University Recruiting CPI in one genuine send under explicit per_candidate matching. The missing-ACK control abstains. Privacy-disclosure intent remains unguarded because the supported lexical evidence also matches a quoted/negated refusal.
